verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official web crawler or prebuilt data connectors. Orama Cloud's 'data sources' are only described as segregated document sets that can be updated independently. Ingestion is shown only through SDK and API calls such as insert and insertMultiple, which means writing your own pipeline, and the Cloud REST APIs are described as private.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline
